vendorArtifacts.provenance: First-use pins, not upstream-published checksums. npm verifies each platform tarball against the registry's sha512 at install time, but a global install keeps no record of it, and @openai/codex publishes no per-file digests. These are the bytes that ran every verified task in this repository: darwin-arm64 from the local npm install that is packaged into MyDouBao.app, linux-arm64 from the sandbox image (sha256:f7a2c6899113e25680cdc3560f44ece7b8f7669c1f22e16ee6ae8e05747bce8c) that ran the live scheduled tasks. A new Codex version is pinned the same way only after its own contract runs pass.

sandbox.baseImageNote: The multi-platform index digest Docker recorded when node:22-bookworm-slim was pulled for the image that ran the live scheduled tasks. The tag moves; this does not.

linux-arm64.purpose: scheduled-task sandbox image; a Mach-O build cannot run in a Linux container at any architecture

builtFromSource.reason: The published releases are built without the authsidecar tag (.goreleaser.yml sets no build tags), and that binary refuses to run at all when LARKSUITE_CLI_AUTH_PROXY is set: 'the sidecar credential-isolation feature is compiled out'. Since the sandbox reaches Feishu only through that sidecar, the published artifact cannot be used here.
builtFromSource.command: GOOS=linux GOARCH=arm64 go build -trimpath -tags authsidecar -ldflags '-s -w -X github.com/larksuite/cli/internal/build.Version=1.0.78 -X github.com/larksuite/cli/internal/build.Date=2026-07-27' -o lark-cli .
builtFromSource.notByteReproducible: scripts/fetch_meta.py downloads internal/registry/meta_data.json from open.feishu.cn at build time and it is not committed, so two builds of the same commit differ. Verified by behaviour instead: same version string, same 36 top-level commands, accepts LARKSUITE_CLI_AUTH_PROXY, and the upstream sidecar suites pass (extension/credential/sidecar, extension/transport/sidecar, tests/sidecar_e2e).
